svg.aria-label: Alfie, the patient assistant. Grew a triage chatbot into a LangGraph multi-agent system: specialist subgraphs, RAG over pgvector, a typed protocol that lets the model render UI, and a red-flag screener that runs before any model call. Then moved it into its own service that reaches the clinical API only over MCP.
